title: 前副国安顾问Mara Rutman：伊朗核协议谈判失衡，令人不安
speaker: Mara Rutman

segments.en: that we can only hope is somewhere close to what the Obama plan achieved which was to contain Iran's enrichment activity
segments.zh: 我们只能希望接近奥巴马计划所达成的，即限制伊朗的浓缩活动

segments.en: so effectively precluded them from being able to enrich uranium to the point where it could become a nuclear weapon and it required regular inspections
segments.zh: 有效阻止他们浓缩铀至可制造核武器的程度，并要求定期检查

segments.en: in exchange for those things, some sanctions not all sanctions were lifted and some of the frozen assets that Iran had were returned.
segments.zh: 作为交换，部分制裁被解除，伊朗部分冻结资产被归还

segments.en: Under this framework which is just the beginning of discussions they're already getting massive relief from sanctions which is fairly extraordinary and the promise they the commitment they've made on the straight up for moves in terms of opening again is quite tentative
segments.zh: 在这个刚刚开始的讨论框架下，他们已获得大规模制裁减免，这相当不寻常，而他们关于重新开放的承诺却非常初步

segments.en: so it's it's it's um it's pretty disturbing as as you reported in terms of the imbalance here and I will just say John Bolton who who you played a clip from just before who was one of President Trump's national security advisors and President Trump's first term
segments.zh: 所以这相当令人不安，正如你报道的，这里存在不平衡。我要说，约翰·博尔顿，你刚才播放了他的片段，他是特朗普总统第一任期的国家安全顾问

segments.en: is not something that I agree with frequently we worked for very different administrations and there was nothing in what he said that I thought was off base.
segments.zh: 我并不同意他的很多观点，我们为不同的政府工作，但我觉得他说的没有错
